description.en: Bedrock is a CLI tool that bootstraps AI-ready project configurations by generating standardized rules, skills, and project context tailored to tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, and Trae—so you can get consistent, instruction-driven AI behavior with a single command.
description.zh: CLI工具，为AI项目生成标准化的规则、技能和上下文配置

usecases.zh: 为Claude Code、Cursor等工具生成标准化的规则、技能和项目上下文
usecases.en: Generate standardized rules, skills, and project context for tools like Claude Code, Cursor
